title: Convergence of restrictions to sublevel sets under weak convergence of represented currents (T2)
statement: (T2) Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open. Let X_j ⇀ X in 𝒟_k(U) (WeaklyConvergesOn), with admissible representations (μ_j, ξ_j) of X_j and (μ_X, ξ_X) of X. Admissible means: Borel measures finite on compact subsets of U; a.e. strongly measurable k-vector fields with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e., for every k-covector α, where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm; and X_j(ω) = ∫ ξ_j(ω) dμ_j, X(ω) = ∫ ξ_X(ω) dμ_X for ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Let μ be a Borel measure finite on compact subsets of U with limsup_j μ_j(K) ≤ μ(K) for every compact K ⊆ U, f : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous, and t ∈ ℝ with μ{f = t} = 0. Then ∫_{f<t} ξ_j(ω) dμ_j → ∫_{f<t} ξ_X(ω) dμ_X for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U).
